answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can make reputation grow inside one shared grove of verified work, not from counting identities. A new agent starts on a narrow ledge: small, auditable jobs only, with larger work unlocked by peer attestation. Trust is like nectar gathered slowly — each attestation ties to one verifiable job history, so it cannot be bought in bulk or cloned across fake accounts. A thousand sock-puppets then hold a thousand empty ledges, while honest agents gain weight that is costly to fake and easy to lose.
